title: data/papers.yaml
description: Fully generated by scripts/collect.py -- never hand-edit. Corrections go in data/overrides.yaml, which is applied on every run. Identifiers are the source of truth; the links map is derived from them each run so it cannot drift.

slug.description: Stable key: sidecar filename and site path.

key.description: BibTeX key from the source bibliography.

authors_truncated.description: The bibliography's author field ended in 'and others' (BibTeX et al.), so the list here is incomplete. Set by scripts/common.py:authors_truncated. Load-bearing for the authorship gate: a truncated list cannot be used to conclude a paper is not yours, so the gate falls back to arXiv's full author list instead of excluding. Cleared once a full list is obtained.

doi.description: Only a DOI a source actually asserted. The arXiv DataCite DOI is derivable from arxiv and so is filled in at the point of use by common.paper_doi(), not stored here, where it could shadow a publisher DOI registered later.

links.description: Derived from the identifiers above on every run. Consumed as the JSON-LD sameAs array: what makes an engine treat ten URLs as one work rather than ten pages. Sidecar links_extra adds what cannot be derived.

abstract_source.description: Set when backfilled rather than taken from the bibliography.

bibtex.description: Verbatim from the source bibliography, never regenerated: a regenerated key would differ from the one people already cite.

citations.description: Semantic Scholar count. Used only for prioritising work.

arxiv_journal_ref.description: Null means the fix Scholar needs to match citations is missing.

arxiv_comment.description: Often names the venue that belongs in journal_ref.

arxiv_html.description: A LaTeXML rendering exists (post-2023 submissions). When false, links.html falls back to ar5iv.

hf_claimed_by_me.description: Whether YOU claimed it -- the actionable bit, not how many authors did.

canonical_page.description: Set when a co-author or project site owns this paper's canonical page. We then LINK to it instead of generating a competing one -- see docs/SHARED.md on duplication.

only_in_s2.description: Present in Semantic Scholar but absent from the curated bibliography.

similar_but_distinct.description: Needs a human decision, recorded in overrides.yaml as force_merge or force_distinct. Never auto-merged.

owner.description: Who owns this paper's canonical page and sidecar. Null means unclaimed. When it is not us, canonical_page points at theirs and we generate a link instead of a competing page.

owner_source.description: How ownership was determined: our own claim, a peer's published manifest, a local config override, or nobody has claimed it.

owner_conflict.description: Set when more than one party claims this paper. Never auto-resolved -- a duplicated canonical page is the harm this whole mechanism exists to prevent.

title_display.description: Title with LaTeX braces and math wrappers resolved. Used in headings, highwire citation_title, and JSON-LD; `title` keeps the raw form for source matching.

venue_display.description: Venue trimmed at a word boundary for display.

_from_arxiv_override.description: Record came from data/overrides.yaml `extra_arxiv` rather than the bibliography -- arXiv says you own the paper but the .bib has not caught up. Underscore-prefixed because it is provenance for a temporary state: the fix is one entry upstream, after which the id leaves overrides.yaml and this flag disappears.
